tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H=0.48, far short of the target H=21.9. A measurement near H=20 directly tests the predicted sign reversal and constrains the slow contribution where forecast accuracy matters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five positive short-horizon observations do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from its time constant, so the predicted reversal is not constrained.
Denser short-window sampling would not directly test whether the response reverses near the forecast horizon.
The auxiliary measurement does not constrain the slow adaptation term.
